usageNotes: Use this endpoint to list all SDN fabric configurations defined in the cluster, including OSPF, BGP, OpenFabric, and WireGuard fabrics. Requires 'SDN.Audit' or 'SDN.Allocate' permission on '/sdn/fabrics/<fabric>' — results are automatically scoped to fabrics the caller can see. Use the 'pending' flag to inspect staged-but-not-yet-applied changes, or 'running' to see the actively deployed configuration (the two may differ after edits before an SDN apply).

examples.summary: List all fabrics showing pending (staged) configuration

tips: Omitting both 'pending' and 'running' returns the saved (committed) configuration — not necessarily what is currently running on nodes.
Each returned object includes a 'protocol' field (openfabric, ospf, wireguard, bgp) that determines which other fields are present; filter by protocol to avoid acting on irrelevant fabric types.
The 'digest' field in each entry can be passed to write operations to guard against concurrent modifications.
SDN fabrics are a cluster-wide resource; this endpoint hits the cluster API layer and does not require a specific node to be targeted.
